en.headline: Hong Kong men reach Asian Games sevens final against China
en.dek: The defending champions beat South Korea 35-14 in the semi-final; the women will play Thailand for bronze, RTHK said.
body: Hong Kong's men's sevens team has reached the Asian Games final in Nagoya and will play China for the gold medal, RTHK reported on Saturday.
RTHK said the defending champions beat South Korea 35-14 in the semi-final. In the other semi-final, China beat Japan 10-7.

In the women's competition, Hong Kong, bronze medallists at the previous Games, lost 12-27 to Japan in the semi-final and will play Thailand for bronze, RTHK said. The report did not give a kick-off time for either match.

zh.headline: 港隊男子七人欖球晉亞運決賽 將戰國家隊
zh.dek: 港台報道，衛冤的港隊在四強以35比14勝韓國；女子隊準決賽不敵日本，將與泰國爭銅牌。
body: 港台周六報道，名古屋亞運七人欖球，香港男子隊晉身決賽，將與國家隊爭奪金牌。
港台指，爭取衛冤的港隊在四強以35比14擊敗韓國。另一場四強，國家隊以10比7勝日本。
女子方面，上屆取得銅牌的港隊在準決賽以12比27不敵日本，將與泰國爭奪銅牌。報道沒有交代兩場賽事的開賽時間。
